purpose: Train the fresh two-agent MAPPO R2 baseline with signed-longitudinal action v2 and the bounded route-completion reward v3 while holding critic, scenarios and PPO hyperparameters fixed.

parameter_rationale.reward_protocol: Reward v3 uses bounded route-completion potential as the only positive dense task signal, explicit success/collision terminal outcomes, and bounded overspeed, executed-command-rate, lidar, TTC and lane costs.
parameter_rationale.reward_budget: The registered scales are route=10, success=+10 and collision=-20. Therefore safe partial progress lies between stopped and success, while even a collision at full completion remains below safe stopping before other costs.
parameter_rationale.anti_hacking: The gamma-consistent route potential telescopes under the PPO discount, speed alone has no positive reward, stationary and forward-reverse cycles cannot farm progress, near-goal lingering loses discounted value, and collision takes priority over goal success on the same tick.
parameter_rationale.comfort: Longitudinal smoothness is computed from executed throttle-minus-brake command rate, making throttle and brake symmetric; steering uses the same bounded normalized-rate construction. Physical jerk remains a diagnostic concept and is not mislabeled in the reward.
parameter_rationale.causal_scope: Signed-longitudinal action v2, AgentConditionedCritic, observations, scenarios and all PPO hyperparameters are unchanged from R1 so R2 isolates reward structure and scale.
parameter_rationale.sensitivity: The five registered scripted trajectory orderings must survive independent plus/minus 25 percent variation of task, terminal and smoothness weights before CARLA smoke is allowed.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 remains the single engineering pilot seed; R3 and R4 must complete before any fresh CARLA pilot.
